name: Balatonboglár (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the town arms of Balatonboglár (a quartered red, blue, white and green shield with a bunch of grapes, a chapel, a plough and a lion) above the name BALATONBOGLÁR in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
